implemented_boundary.classification: Admission is keyed on payload.source through a three-valued policy: boundary-required (board-construction) is admitted unconditionally, with or without a marker; boundary-when-marked (system-pick-scanner, alert-agent, model-driven) is admitted only by an explicit metadata.systemGenerated=true marker and is otherwise governed by the source-keyed Phase 7A brake in distribution-service.ts; human-ingress (smart-form, feed, system, api, discord-bot) keeps the validated path. metadata.systemGenerated=true additionally admits any submission, including runtime source values outside PickSource. `as const satisfies Record<PickSource, AutomatedWriteBoundaryPolicy>` makes every current PickSource an explicit, exhaustive classification decision.
implemented_boundary.shared_enforcement_point: apps/api/src/submission-service.ts calls prepareAutomatedSubmission before idempotency lookup and persistence
implemented_boundary.atomicity: The requested initial lifecycle state is supplied to createCanonicalPickFromSubmission and persisted with the pick and birth lifecycle event; no validated-to-awaiting transition is used.
implemented_boundary.approval_dimension_note: approval_status remains separate from picks.status; lifecycle awaiting_approval is the operator-review gate.
implemented_boundary.freshness_posture: market-universe identity, provider market key, snapshot timestamp, provider key, and current freshness are required before any automated submission write.
implemented_boundary.provenance: metadata.automatedWriteBoundary records producer, source, source snapshot time and age, transition actor, transition reason, and required state; the birth lifecycle event uses the same actor role and reason.
implemented_boundary.human_path_preserved: The validated initial state is preserved only for sources classified human-ingress (smart-form, feed, system, api, discord-bot). board-construction is NOT one of them: it is boundary-required, so a board submission enters the boundary and is born in awaiting_approval whether or not it carries metadata.systemGenerated and whether or not an operator originated it. Omitting the marker does not create a human path; once admitted, a missing producer identity or missing market evidence fails closed before persistence.
implemented_boundary.readiness_signal: detectAutomatedDirectToValidatedWrite identifies the forbidden automated validated state and submission idempotency checks fail closed when it is observed.

Transient validated state for boundary-when-marked sources (pre-existing, out of scope, NOT introduced by this lane). An exact-head review observed that a system-pick-scanner / alert-agent / model-driven submission omitting metadata.systemGenerated is not admitted to the write boundary (those sources are classified boundary-when-marked, not human-ingress), so processSubmission persists it as validated before the controller's source-keyed Phase 7A brake moves it to awaiting_approval. Verified: this behaviour is unchanged by this lane (git diff origin/main shows no scanner-path change); the real producer stamps the marker at candidate-pick-scanner.ts:250 and is therefore born in awaiting_approval; and the controller applies the brake by source before any distribution enqueue, so no outbox row or run is created from the transient state. detectAutomatedDirectToValidatedWrite documents the choice deliberately: flagging an unmarked boundary-when-marked source by source alone would turn a lawful in-flight state into a hard failure on the idempotent re-submission path, and would fail closed on ratified fixtures that carry no producer identity or market evidence. Residual exposure, corrected after adversarial review found the first statement too narrow: enqueueDistributionWork's defense-in-depth check (distribution-service.ts:238) is lifecycle-state-only, not source-aware, and requeue-controller.ts does not re-check isGovernanceBrakeSource. An operator-authenticated caller who already knew the pick id could therefore ACT ON the transient row inside that window and enqueue it for real distribution, not merely observe it. Bounded by operator-role auth, a single-round-trip window with no external point at which the id becomes knowable, and candidate-pick-scanner.ts's void_advanced fallback. Pre-existing, not introduced here, and recorded as a tracked follow-up because making enqueueDistributionWork source-aware touches the distribution path beyond this lane's authorized scope. Broader compile-time exhaustiveness hardening for GOVERNANCE_BRAKE_SOURCES is tracked separately and this lane's issue explicitly directs that it not be re-scoped here. This limitation is scoped strictly to boundary-when-marked sources and has no board-construction analogue: board-construction is boundary-required, so it is admitted by source and has no legal validated state, transient or resting.
